name: Pyrewood Shackle
summary: At Pyrewood Village, enchanted shackles bind its beleaguered inhabitants to Archmage Arugal's strange magic. The bands are tied to the dark fate that grips the townsfolk when night falls.

sections.title: Arugal's Binding Magic
sections.body: Pyrewood's residents live ordinary lives by day, appearing as humans, then become feral Moonrage worgen at sunset. Archmage Arugal bound the villagers in enchanted shackles as part of his experiments with worgen sorcery. At the Sepulcher, Forsaken arcane researcher Dalar Dawnweaver studies the bands to learn what their enchantments do. He gathers and examines the lingering energy on them, hoping to understand Arugal's magic and loosen the mad archmage's hold over the region.

faq.q: What are Pyrewood Shackles used for?
faq.answer: At the Sepulcher, Dalar Dawnweaver studies the shackles' enchantments. He hopes their magic will help him unravel Archmage Arugal's spells and dismantle the archmage's influence in Silverpine Forest.
The cursed residents of Pyrewood Village in southern Silverpine Forest carry the shackles. They wear them as humans by day and as Moonrage worgen by night.

faq.q: Why do the villagers transform at night?
faq.answer: Archmage Arugal's reckless experiments and enchantments made Pyrewood's residents change at night. The shackles hold an enchantment that lets them appear as ordinary humans in daylight, while darkness reveals their feral worgen forms.
Dalar Dawnweaver is a Forsaken mage at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. He studies arcane anomalies left by Archmage Arugal, seeking to break the archmage's curses.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you know Arugal's rampant sorcery threatens your borders. Collecting these enchanted bindings is vital to neutralizing Shadowfang Keep's influence.
As a mage, you can recognize the reckless transmutation and binding magic woven into ordinary steel.
